raised: Top menu bar meant nothing to the reader
The '123 מקור / חושב / הזנתה' line under the title was confusing and unexplained
The term 'נאמן' (trustee) went over their head
The buying/selling paragraph lost them: cut-off time, 'מפיץ', and codes like MF-11 / MF OQ3
The site's open question about trading on Friday made them nervous
The costs paragraph gives no actual management-fee number and points to an unclear 'number below' link
Didn't understand the loss-offset line ('הפסד בקרן ניתן לקיזוז')
The 'play with your numbers' calculator was collapsed/closed
Contradiction: 3.25% shown as before tax and costs in one place, after management fees in another
No information on when the money actually reaches the account after selling
Cost table disappointing: 'אין תקרה בחוק' on most rows was worrying and there's no column with actual percentages
Gave up on the tax paragraph about nominal vs real gain and the 2 of 73 funds
The possibility of redemptions being suspended for days is scary for money they might need
Didn't understand what the chart tabs (מיד / ביום מסחר / ...) would change
Rule codes like MF-16, BRK-17, BANK-18 in the 'חוקים וכללים' column mean nothing
Unclear who is the trustee and who is the fund manager
Didn't understand what 'פטורה' / 'חייבת' means for them
Unclear whether a securities account is needed or already exists
Missing a simple worked example of what you'd be left with after fees and tax
No guidance on how to choose between funds
No information on any minimum amount
No step-by-step for buying a fund in the bank app
Would drop the terms table, 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון', and 'מי מציע ומי מפקח' first

problems.why: The report never mentions that the comparison names a single bank (Leumi) or cites that bank's deposit rate; it only says it ignored source tags like 'ריבית שפורסמה', and that isn't a complaint about singling out one bank.
